expectation_gap.meaning: A documented mismatch between an employer promise and reported work experience.

brand_misalignment.meaning: Brand messaging diverges from observed employee experience.

documented_broken_promise.meaning: A dated recruiting claim and a specific contrary practice are verified for the same cohort.

expectations_met.meaning: Comparable hires report that specific recruiting promises are being met.

manager_support.meaning: Employees report insufficient coaching, support or authority.

manager_practice_verified.meaning: Interviews or records verify a management practice such as restricted decision rights or missing coaching.

career_clarity.meaning: Employees report unclear growth or advancement expectations.

role_clarity_failure.meaning: A review verifies inconsistent onboarding responsibilities, role expectations or progression criteria.

early_attrition.meaning: Early exits rise for a defined entry cohort and follow-up window.

pay_gap_verified.meaning: Matched role and location records show a meaningful internal or external pay discrepancy.

burnout.meaning: A cohort reports sustained work-related exhaustion or strain.

workload_verified.meaning: Overtime, staffing or workload records show sustained excess demand in the same cohort.

adequate_workload.meaning: Comparable workload records show adequate capacity over the disputed window.

schedule_instability.meaning: Roster records show short-notice changes or inconsistent hours in a shift-based cohort.

shift_based_work.meaning: The cohort works shifts that can vary within and across weeks.

mobile_exposure.meaning: The target candidates predominantly encounter the mobile experience.

mobile_friction.meaning: Intake reports a hard-to-use form, account wall or upload difficulty.

form_obstacle_verified.meaning: A candidate walkthrough or step events reproduce a blocking form obstacle.

application_abandonment.meaning: Candidates who start the application abandon it before submission.

form_completes.meaning: Eligible target candidates complete the instrumented form without unusual loss.

application_loss.meaning: Fewer portal visits convert to submitted applications for the target role.
application_loss.intake_pattern: applications are down|low qualified applicant conversion|weak applicant conversion

handoff_delay_reported.meaning: The intake identifies slow recruiter response after application or interview.
handoff_delay_reported.intake_pattern: slow candidate response|slow local[^.;]{0,50}interview handoffs|handoff delays|recruiter response delays

handoff_delay_verified.meaning: Application system timestamps locate the delay between distinct post-submission events.

hiring_delay.meaning: The target cohort has protracted time from requisition to accepted offer.

agency_spend.meaning: The target role relies heavily on external staffing or agencies.

agency_dependency_verified.meaning: Invoices or placement records document agency reliance for the affected roles.

generic_ads.meaning: Job information omits relevant role details.

role_info_gap_verified.meaning: An ad audit verifies that requirements or valued job conditions are missing.

weak_reach.meaning: The channel has poor reach or discoverability for the target audience.
weak_reach.intake_pattern: near.zero reach|low organic reach|low passive candidate awareness

corporate_engagement_weak.meaning: Corporate posts receive comparatively weak engagement.

local_reputation.meaning: Ratings vary across comparable sites, or site-level evidence is uneven.

review_coverage.meaning: Review volume, site counts and coverage affect the reliability of the reputation signal.

local_issue_verified.meaning: Site records or scoped listening verify a local employment or candidate experience issue.

employer_reputation_weak.meaning: Public reviews show weak perception of the employer.

review_tracking.meaning: Review monitoring or responses are handled manually or inconsistently.

feedback_fragmentation.meaning: Candidate feedback is collected in disconnected formats or systems.

feedback_workflow_verified.meaning: A workflow audit verifies inconsistent invitations, capture, or ownership.

low_survey_coverage.meaning: A small share of eligible candidates complete the feedback survey.
low_survey_coverage.intake_pattern: low (?:survey )?response rate|low survey completion|poor feedback response

post_tracking.meaning: HR reports manual recording of employee posts or campaign results.

tracking_workflow_verified.meaning: A workflow audit identifies manual steps, duplicates or missing attribution.

manual_tracking_load.meaning: HR spends time on manual review or post tracking.

existing_advocates.meaning: Employees already post voluntarily, regardless of formal program status.

volunteers_verified.meaning: Opt-in and relevant participation are verified for the target cohort.

culture_ready.meaning: Scoped evidence supports credible internal experience and willingness to participate.

employee_engagement_reference.meaning: Peer benchmark for employee-post engagement. It is not observed client engagement.

emv.meaning: Finance requires an attributable and auditable measure of the employer-brand program.

attrition_exposure.meaning: Estimated cost of attrition. Expected exposure and realized savings are separate.

protected_retention.meaning: A reported healthy retention baseline for a specific cohort.

qualified_supply_verified.meaning: A role and location audit finds too few eligible applicants despite comparable distribution and a working apply flow.

qualified_supply_reported.meaning: Intake reports too few suitably qualified applicants.
qualified_supply_reported.intake_pattern: (?:too few|scarce|shortage of|few) (?:suitably )?qualified (?:applicants|candidates)|qualified applicant supply is limited

qualified_supply_adequate.meaning: The relevant requisitions have a sufficient number of applicants meeting validated essential criteria.

approval_queue_verified.meaning: Workflow timestamps show elapsed time between a documented hiring request and approval or release.

approval_queue_reported.meaning: Intake reports vacancies waiting for budget or requisition sign-off.

approval_on_time.meaning: Comparable hiring requests are approved or deliberately closed within the agreed local interval.

vacancy_delay.meaning: A workforce need remains open longer than expected from request through hire.

interview_capacity_verified.meaning: Scheduling records verify that eligible screened candidates wait for interview slots or panel capacity.

interview_capacity_reported.meaning: Intake reports difficulty booking an interview or assembling a panel after screening.

interviews_on_time.meaning: Comparable eligible candidates receive feasible interview slots without a material queue.

offer_decline_rate.meaning: A high share of extended offers are declined for the target cohort.

offer_terms_mismatch_verified.meaning: Exit or decline records identify specific offer conditions that diverge from candidate requirements.

offer_terms_mismatch_reported.meaning: Candidates reportedly cite terms, working conditions or timing when declining offers.

offer_terms_accepted.meaning: Comparable candidates report that the offer terms meet their needs.

qualified_screen_loss.meaning: Qualified applicants are lost between application and screening progression.

screening_criteria_mismatch_verified.meaning: An audit identifies screen criteria or questions that do not reflect validated essential role requirements.

screening_criteria_mismatch_reported.meaning: Intake reports a mismatch between screening and actual role requirements.

screening_criteria_validated.meaning: Independent review confirms the criteria reflect essential job requirements.

channel_target_mismatch_verified.meaning: Attribution and audience data show that the channel reaches a different population from the intended job cohort.

channel_target_mismatch_reported.meaning: The intake distinguishes a channel's current audience from the target candidates.

channel_target_reached.meaning: The current channel gives the intended cohort sufficient opportunity to see the posting.

prestart_loss.meaning: A material share of accepted offers fail to become starts.
prestart_loss.intake_pattern: accepted offers? (?:do|did) not (?:turn into|become) starts|(?:pre.start|first.day) no.shows

prestart_gap_verified.meaning: Accepted offers and pre-start contact records identify missed or conflicting steps preceding scheduled starts.

prestart_gap_reported.meaning: Intake reports broken follow-up between offer acceptance and start.

prestart_steps_completed.meaning: Accepted candidates received and confirmed their required pre-start information.

internal_mobility_barrier_verified.meaning: A review finds qualified staff unable to discover or pursue available internal roles.

internal_mobility_barrier_reported.meaning: Employees report limited access to internal openings or transfers.
internal_mobility_barrier_reported.intake_pattern: (?:internal vacancies|internal jobs) (?:are )?(?:not posted|hidden)|(?:blocked|prevented) from applying internally

internal_mobility_accessible.meaning: Eligible employees can discover and apply for the relevant internal roles.

voluntary_exit_increase.meaning: Voluntary exits increased in a defined workforce and observation period.

flexibility_barrier_verified.meaning: Employees in the cohort identify a specific commuting or work-location constraint and the timing is verified.

flexibility_barrier_reported.meaning: Employees cite commuting or location requirements when considering leaving.

flexibility_feasible.meaning: Work design, customer coverage and access requirements permit a local hybrid-work trial.

flexibility_infeasible.meaning: The role's essential work or access requirements prevent the proposed hybrid arrangement.

speak_up_barrier_verified.meaning: Independent confidential channels corroborate fear of speaking up or retaliation for raising concerns.

speak_up_barrier_reported.meaning: Employees report fear of speaking up about problems.
speak_up_barrier_reported.intake_pattern: (?:fear of|afraid to) speak(?:ing)? up|fear of retaliation

low_speak_up_participation.meaning: Two-way reporting shows low issue-raising or follow-up coverage despite a defined opportunity to report.

safe_voice_corroborated.meaning: Multiple confidential sources corroborate practical access to a safe channel for raising concerns.

review_sample_shift_verified.meaning: Review composition, platform mix or collection coverage changed in the relevant comparison period.

review_sample_shift_reported.meaning: Intake reports a change in the mix of reviewers or review platforms.

review_collection_stable.meaning: Platform and cohort breakdowns show stable coverage over comparable periods.

tracking_attribution_gap_verified.meaning: A reconciliation finds duplicate, unmatched or missing source IDs in campaign-to-outcome records.

tracking_attribution_gap_reported.meaning: The intake reports missing attribution or duplicate tracking records.

campaign_outcomes_unmeasured.meaning: Eligible reach or downstream hiring outcomes are unavailable or cannot be reconciled.

attribution_reconciled.meaning: A source-to-outcome reconciliation confirms the relevant records and definitions reconcile.

earnest_2011.finding: Realistic job previews were linked to voluntary turnover through perceived organizational honesty in a meta-analytic path analysis.
earnest_2011.limitation: Supports an expectations mechanism. It does not identify a client-specific effect or a star-gap threshold.

zhao_2007.finding: Psychological contract breach was related to work attitudes and turnover intentions; the meta-analysis did not find a reliable association with actual turnover.
zhao_2007.limitation: Verify why employees left and test alternative contributors.

bauer_2007.finding: Newcomer adjustment includes role clarity, which was related to downstream work outcomes.
bauer_2007.limitation: Does not quantify the impact of a promotion framework on a given cohort.

friebel_2021.finding: A field experiment gave retail managers explicit retention goals and measured quits.
friebel_2021.limitation: A retail management intervention provides a directional precedent, with different context and intervention from coaching elsewhere.

demerouti_2001.finding: Job demands and resources measured across occupational groups relate to different burnout dimensions.
demerouti_2001.limitation: A reported workload problem is not a clinical diagnosis or proof of turnover causation.

bes_2023.finding: Controlled studies found a small pooled reduction in exhaustion after organizational interventions, with very low certainty.
bes_2023.limitation: Do not transfer the pooled effect to a client or infer impact on actual exits.

w3c_forms.finding: Accessible forms use necessary inputs, clear labels and recoverable errors.
w3c_forms.limitation: Design guidance, with no universal completion-time target or effect size.

appcast.finding: Observed apply completion varied with application length.
appcast.limitation: Vendor observations can help design a test. They do not identify a causal effect for a new applicant funnel.

hausknecht_2004.finding: Favorable applicant reactions related to employer perceptions and reported acceptance and recommendation intentions.
hausknecht_2004.limitation: Does not establish a universal callback SLA or a conversion uplift.

williamson_2010.finding: Reputation, job and company information, and site vividness interacted in business students’ perceptions of recruiting firms.
williamson_2010.limitation: Perceptions from this sample do not establish a site-specific applicant conversion effect.

edwards_2023.finding: Shorter questionnaires and selected reminders can improve response in some settings.
edwards_2023.limitation: Response and representativeness are distinct; local candidate effects are unknown.

marinescu_2021.finding: Voluntary employer reviews can overrepresent extreme opinions.
marinescu_2021.limitation: Ratings and review volume cannot establish a local operational cause by themselves.

van_hoye_2016.finding: Recruitment word-of-mouth studies found that source and disclosed incentives influenced employer attractiveness.
van_hoye_2016.limitation: Does not prove the success or harm of a given advocacy campaign.

amec.finding: AMEC calls for outcome and impact measurement and rejects advertising value equivalency as a measure of communication value.
amec.limitation: An unattributed media cost estimate is not realized ROI.

dube_2019.finding: A retail quasi-experiment linked unequal raises and quit behavior.
dube_2019.limitation: Relevant as an alternative to test using comparable roles, with no transferable pay or quit threshold.

kesavan_2022.finding: An experiment in retail tested a bundle of more responsible scheduling practices and reported store performance effects.
kesavan_2022.limitation: Does not establish a universal retention effect or fit for other shift-based roles.

ingaze_policy.finding: The challenge requires readiness gates, workforce fit and a three-phase plan.
ingaze_policy.limitation: Policy constraint, not a published causal estimate.

davis_2013.finding: US establishment data show heterogeneity in vacancies, hiring rates and recruiting intensity.
davis_2013.limitation: An aggregate time-to-fill or low qualified count does not establish labor scarcity. Verify exposure, role requirements and competing stages locally.

opm_hiring_roadmap.finding: The federal hiring roadmap separates needs validation, review, interviews and offers into stages.
opm_hiring_roadmap.limitation: Use only as a process measurement example. Its deadlines and governance requirements are specific to its setting.

chapman_2005.finding: The meta-analysis examined associations of job, organizational and recruitment-process characteristics with applicant attraction, intentions and job choice.
chapman_2005.limitation: Does not establish why a specific offer was declined or isolate the effect of changing a term.

keppeler_papenfuss.finding: Social media field experiments tested employer messages using clicks as an early indicator of interest.
keppeler_papenfuss.limitation: A click is neither a qualified application nor a hire. The setting was public employers.

pre_entry_withdrawal.finding: The authors studied pre-entry withdrawal after acceptance, including an archival telecommunications sample.
pre_entry_withdrawal.limitation: The reported rate belongs to that sample. The source does not prove a specific communication workflow prevents nonstarts.

keller_2018.finding: An analysis of internal hires at one health-services firm compared posting with manager-designated moves and found differing outcomes.
keller_2018.limitation: Observational evidence from one firm cannot establish a universal causal retention effect.

bloom_2024.finding: A randomized trial at a Chinese technology company evaluated a specific hybrid schedule and found lower attrition in the treatment group.
bloom_2024.limitation: Applies to the studied schedule and role setting. Verify feasibility and measure local outcomes.

edmondson_1999.finding: A study of manufacturing teams found team psychological safety associated with learning behavior.
edmondson_1999.limitation: Low reporting alone cannot diagnose fear or establish a turnover effect. Confidential verification and applicable case procedures are needed.

lacerenza_2017.finding: A meta-analysis examined effectiveness and design moderators of leadership training.
lacerenza_2017.limitation: Training outcomes do not establish a client's turnover effect. Evaluate management behavior and local retention separately.

expectation_drift.label: Expectation drift may contribute to early exits
expectation_drift.diagnostic: Compare dated promises, observed work practices and reasons for exits over a comparable hire window.
expectation_drift.pilot: Pilot accurate role previews and correct the verified gap in work practices.
expectation_drift.scale_gate: Scale when new hires report alignment and comparable early-exit indicators improve.

management_practice.label: A management practice may contribute to exits
management_practice.diagnostic: Compare exits and reported decision rights or manager practices across comparable teams and tenure.
management_practice.pilot: Pilot manager coaching and an explicit agreement on delegation in affected teams.
management_practice.scale_gate: Extend after delegation feedback and comparable early retention improve.

onboarding_clarity.label: Unclear role or progression expectations may contribute to early exits
onboarding_clarity.diagnostic: Review onboarding responsibilities, leveling criteria and exit reasons by role and cohort.
onboarding_clarity.pilot: Pilot a structured onboarding and role-expectation review with a named owner.
onboarding_clarity.scale_gate: Expand after role clarity improves and comparable exit indicators show no deterioration.

workload_strain.label: Excess workload may contribute to employee exhaustion
workload_strain.diagnostic: Compare staffing, overtime and confidential listening by cohort; check schedule instability and workload changes.
workload_strain.pilot: Co-design a capacity or workload change in the affected team.
workload_strain.scale_gate: Scale after sustained workload and exhaustion measures improve without shifting the burden to another cohort.

application_friction.label: A mobile application obstacle may explain pre-submission loss
application_friction.diagnostic: Compare starts and submissions by device and role, then reproduce the failure at the suspected form step.
application_friction.pilot: Pilot an accessible form that keeps eligibility questions and removes a verified obstacle.
application_friction.scale_gate: Expand after qualified submissions improve without worse eligibility, accessibility or recruiter response.

recruiter_handoff.label: A post-submission handoff may explain hiring delays
recruiter_handoff.diagnostic: Measure elapsed time from submission to first contact and subsequent funnel stages by cohort.
recruiter_handoff.pilot: Pilot a named recruiter queue and response review for the affected roles.
recruiter_handoff.scale_gate: Expand after response times and qualified progression improve without shifting the queue elsewhere.

role_information.label: Unclear role information may weaken candidate attraction
role_information.diagnostic: Interview target candidates and review conversion for the same jobs and inbound channels.
role_information.pilot: Test verified role details in job ads and compare qualified completions for similar traffic.
role_information.scale_gate: Scale after qualified applications improve while access and eligibility hold.

reputation_location.label: A local operating issue may explain uneven site reputation
reputation_location.diagnostic: Compare themes, sample counts and local operational records for the affected sites.
reputation_location.pilot: Pilot local ownership and fix the issue independently verified at those sites.
reputation_location.scale_gate: Expand the workflow after coverage and local operational outcomes improve.

feedback_coverage.label: Fragmented feedback collection may hide candidate experience issues
feedback_coverage.diagnostic: Reconcile eligible candidates, invitations, responses and timestamps by stage and site.
feedback_coverage.pilot: Pilot a short accessible survey and documented invitations at an affected site.
feedback_coverage.scale_gate: Expand once response coverage improves and nonresponse patterns are checked.

manual_measurement.label: Manual workflows may limit reporting coverage and consume staff time
manual_measurement.diagnostic: Audit duplicate handling, reporting effort, source coverage, and ownership.
manual_measurement.pilot: Instrument verified tracking steps with source IDs and document staff time and conversion separately.
manual_measurement.scale_gate: Expand after completeness, auditability and staff time improve.

advocacy_pilot.label: An existing willing cohort may support a scoped advocacy pilot
advocacy_pilot.diagnostic: Verify target audience fit, meaningful outcomes, voluntary participation and readiness in the relevant cohort.
advocacy_pilot.pilot: Trial opt-in, role-relevant participation with auditable tracking.
advocacy_pilot.scale_gate: Expand only with credible internal conditions, consent and measured audience or hiring outcomes.

external_staffing_dependency.label: A delayed hire process may contribute to agency dependence
external_staffing_dependency.diagnostic: Reconcile agency invoices and filled requisitions, then identify the funnel stage delaying the same roles.
external_staffing_dependency.pilot: Pilot targeted recruiter capacity for roles with verified avoidable external spend.
external_staffing_dependency.scale_gate: Scale after direct qualified hires improve and Finance verifies changes in agency spend.

compensation_pressure.label: A cohort-specific pay gap may contribute to exits
compensation_pressure.diagnostic: Audit comparable pay and exit reasons within the same role, location and tenure window.
compensation_pressure.pilot: If a meaningful discrepancy is verified, pilot a targeted compensation correction with Finance.
compensation_pressure.scale_gate: Review fairness and comparable retention before expanding any pay change.

schedule_instability.label: Short-notice or unstable shifts may contribute to work strain
schedule_instability.diagnostic: Compare roster notice, coverage and strain; check whether the target workforce actually works shifts.
schedule_instability.pilot: Pilot more predictable shift assignments with the affected workers and operational owner.
schedule_instability.scale_gate: Expand if roster stability improves without worse coverage or workload.

qualified_applicant_supply.label: A limited qualified applicant pool may delay hiring
qualified_applicant_supply.diagnostic: Count qualified applicants per approved requisition by role and market. Verify essential criteria, distribution and form completion before calling the pool small.
qualified_applicant_supply.pilot: Test one additional sourcing route for the verified role and region. Track eligible applicants per requisition and keep essential qualifications fixed.
qualified_applicant_supply.scale_gate: Expand if eligible applicants per opening and qualified hires improve without worsening cost or assessment quality.

requisition_approval.label: A pre-posting approval queue may delay vacancy fulfillment
requisition_approval.diagnostic: Compare request, sign-off, posting and acceptance timestamps. Verify whether the time-to-hire clock even includes time in approval.
requisition_approval.pilot: Pilot a standard request checklist and named approver for one role family while retaining existing hiring and budget controls.
requisition_approval.scale_gate: Expand if the request-to-post interval improves and approval exceptions or hiring-control failures do not increase.

interview_capacity.label: Interview slot availability may delay qualified candidates
interview_capacity.diagnostic: Measure screens, scheduling attempts and actual interview starts. Separate panel capacity from recruiter contact and candidate availability.
interview_capacity.pilot: Reserve interview blocks with trained backup interviewers and let eligible candidates choose accessible slots.
interview_capacity.scale_gate: Expand after verified interview wait times fall and assessment quality and candidate access hold.

offer_acceptance.label: Offer conditions may explain a late-stage loss of candidates
offer_acceptance.diagnostic: Reconcile extended, declined and expired offers. Confirm role-level decline reasons and separate terms, approval timing and competing offers.
offer_acceptance.pilot: Test clearer and earlier disclosure of approved offer conditions. Escalate term changes through the relevant decision owners.
offer_acceptance.scale_gate: Expand if offer acceptance and subsequent starts improve while compensation and fairness controls hold.

screening_mismatch.label: Off-target screening criteria may exclude eligible applicants
screening_mismatch.diagnostic: Manually review de-identified decisions against job-validated essentials and look for structured counterexamples before changing the screen.
screening_mismatch.pilot: Review questioned criteria with HR and role experts and pilot a documented, job-relevant rubric with human review.
screening_mismatch.scale_gate: Expand only after assessment quality and accessible progression improve while required qualifications are preserved.

channel_reach_mismatch.label: A sourcing channel may be missing the intended workforce
channel_reach_mismatch.diagnostic: Compare target cohort impressions, qualified visits and application outcomes by channel. Check whether the issue is reach, ad information or the apply flow.
channel_reach_mismatch.pilot: Test one role-appropriate channel with comparable job information and attributable qualified outcomes.
channel_reach_mismatch.scale_gate: Expand if incremental qualified reach and applications justify the cost and there is no reduction in access.

prestart_withdrawal.label: A pre-start communication gap may contribute to nonstarts
prestart_withdrawal.diagnostic: Check accepted offers, scheduled starts, withdrawals and confirmed contact while preserving candidate confidentiality.
prestart_withdrawal.pilot: Pilot an opt-in contact schedule with confirmed instructions, a named contact and a way to resolve access or scheduling problems.
prestart_withdrawal.scale_gate: Expand after measured starts improve without intrusive follow-up or worse candidate experience.

internal_mobility_access.label: Restricted access to internal openings may contribute to exits
internal_mobility_access.diagnostic: Compare internal posting visibility, applicant access and exit themes by role and tenure. Check actual opportunities apart from clarity about progression.
internal_mobility_access.pilot: Pilot transparent access to relevant vacancies and a documented transfer review, preserving eligibility and role requirements.
internal_mobility_access.scale_gate: Expand if equitable access and mobility improve while monitoring retention in the same group.

work_location_flexibility.label: A feasible location change may address a reported retention barrier
work_location_flexibility.diagnostic: Verify commute or location concerns in the affected cohort and confirm that service, access and team responsibilities allow a trial.
work_location_flexibility.pilot: Test an opt-in, role-compatible schedule for one cohort with coverage and collaboration safeguards.
work_location_flexibility.scale_gate: Expand only if the local trial meets coverage, collaboration and retention criteria.

speak_up_barriers.label: Fear of speaking up may limit visibility into workplace problems
speak_up_barriers.diagnostic: Compare confidential reporting access, independently corroborated concerns and follow-up coverage. Refer individual allegations to appropriate safeguarding processes.
speak_up_barriers.pilot: Pilot confidential aggregate listening and tracked follow-up with a responsible HR owner. Keep individual case handling outside this workflow.
speak_up_barriers.scale_gate: Expand only after safe access and response quality are demonstrated. Assess participation separately from incident prevalence.

review_sample_shift.label: Review collection changes may explain some apparent reputation movement
review_sample_shift.diagnostic: Compare review counts and respondent mix by platform, site and period. Cross-check changes against independent operational and listening records.
review_sample_shift.pilot: Publish a coverage-aware reputation view separating like-for-like trends from composition changes.
review_sample_shift.scale_gate: Expand when independent site evidence is linked and coverage differences are visible in management reports.

campaign_attribution_gap.label: Missing attribution limits what can be inferred about hiring impact
campaign_attribution_gap.diagnostic: Reconcile source identifiers and downstream events. Check whether reach, candidate response or qualified outcomes are genuinely unmeasured.
campaign_attribution_gap.pilot: Pilot an auditable source-to-outcome ledger with deduplicated events and separate reporting for reach, qualified applications and hires.
campaign_attribution_gap.scale_gate: Expand after completeness and reconciliation improve and comparisons use consistent outcome definitions.
